page_title: AUG 2-0 UNI | Augsburg v Union Berlin 12/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Arne Maier (Augsburg) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
90+5' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Frederik Ronnow.
90+4' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.
90+2' Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Stieler and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Tobias Stieler blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Union Berlin have a free kick.
88' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.
87' Union Berlin control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
86' That's unlucky! Alex Kral (Union Berlin) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
81' 2 - 0 Sven Michel (Augsburg) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball under the crossbar.
81' The Augsburg players joy may have been justified, because referee Tobias Stieler is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
81' Sven Michel (Augsburg) has a goal ruled out for offside!
80' Substitution. Mert Komur (Augsburg) has come on for Maximilian Bauer.
78' Arne Maier (Augsburg) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
77' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Poor challenge! Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) is penalised for tripping and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benedict Hollerbach leaves the pitch and Chris Bedia (Union Berlin) comes on.
75' It will be a substitution. Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) is ready to enter the pitch as Rani Khedira walks off.
73' Substitution. Arne Engels did his best and is replaced by Sven Michel (Augsburg).
73' Jess Thorup has decided to substitute Phillip Tietz and he is replaced by Patric Pfeiffer (Augsburg).
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Union Berlin.
68' The ball falls kindly for Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just over the bar.
66' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Christopher Trimmel as he is replaced by Janik Haberer (Union Berlin).
66' Nenad Bjelica has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) replacing Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen.

65' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Finn Dahmen to get hold of the ball.
64' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort.
62' Ruben Vargas will be replaced by Pep Biel (Augsburg).
60' A pass from Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) is intercepted by Frederik Ronnow and the move breaks down.
58' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
56' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
55' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
53' Handball! A player from Union Berlin handled the ball.
51' Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
47' 1 - 0 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Phillip Tietz (Augsburg), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:0.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Arne Maier (Augsburg) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
40' There's an opportunity for Arne Maier (Augsburg) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
39' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
37' Tobias Stieler shows the yellow card to Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) for a heavy challenge.
36' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
33' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
33' Augsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
32' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Arne Engels (Augsburg). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Augsburg.
28' Union Berlin concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
26' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
25' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
24' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
22' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
19' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Augsburg.
13' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
11' Tobias Stieler blows the whistle, Alex Kral (Union Berlin) is penalised for a foul.
9' A player from Union Berlin commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
9' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tobias Stieler blows for a foul.
7' Arne Maier (Augsburg) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
6' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Augsburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
5' Union Berlin seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
1' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle. Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg) commits a foul after dangerous play. Union Berlin are awarded the free kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
Tobias Stieler will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
